I don't have Microsoft's full fiscal 2026 results (year ending June 30, 2026), so this is an estimate rather than a reported figure: operating income grew roughly 19%.

- **Fiscal 2025 operating income:** about $128.5 billion, as reported.
- **Fiscal 2026 operating income:** about $153 billion, my estimate. It rests on my recollection of the first two quarters (about $38.0 billion and $38.3 billion) plus my own projection of roughly $37–40 billion for each of the remaining two.

That gives ($153B − $128.5B) / $128.5B ≈ 19%. The actual figure could differ by a few points either way.
